headline: Disneyland to Transition Autopia Ride Vehicles to Electric Power
summary: Disneyland's Autopia ride will replace its gas-powered engines with electric vehicles after the previous engines were not properly certified.
why: Theme park operations and capital expenditures reflect corporate investments in environmental compliance and fleet modernization.

impacts.name: The Walt Disney Company
impacts.why: Disneyland operates as a key asset under the Walt Disney Company corporate umbrella.
